description: Decode one caller-supplied EVM ERC-20 Transfer log into from, to and exact atomic value. Optional decimals formats a decimal string. No RPC, chain verification, token identity check or trading. Works with standard logs on EVM chains. Costs $0.0027 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
name: erc20_decode
title: Johto Data ERC-20 Transfer Decode
